title: Von Miller agrees to 1-year contract with the Dallas Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Von Miller agrees to 1-year contract with the Dallas Cowboys
sources.description: Von Miller is set to sign with his hometown Dallas Cowboys and doesn't even want to wait a week for the team to get back from training camp in California.
